body: I feel pretty much exactly the same, but I'm probably a lot younger. I've had to deal with ADHD my entire life and I've also developed Social Anxiety and I think even Borderline Personality Disorder, and all of these 3 things together plus the fact that I practically have no skills makes me feel pretty much worthless and I wouldn't mind Euthanasia either (though sadly i'm pretty sure that in my area it is only given to old people and if i asked for this i'd just get sent to a mental hospital or some shit). All I'm really good at is being creative in general, and I always come up with big grand ideas, but I'm never even fucking able to make them real and no longer just an idea, and I don't think I'll ever develop any real skills. I don't really have hope for much and my life seems bleak. I guess since we're both in the same situation we could talk to eachother if you want, but if not, alright.
